pages.text: It wants to know more than it can see. It buds a $(l)Cortex Offshoot$() (research), which I plant in a past era. There it has ages to grow, so when I am home again, an old, petrified $(l)Fossil Cortex$() is waiting at the very spot.

pages.title: The Nerve
pages.text: A $(l)Nerve Spool$() (string, rotten flesh, brass) carries the memory home. Use it on the fossil, then on the Chronocortex, however far apart.$(br2)Each era it remembers makes it more aware, opens the next era, and gives it new things to say. Remembering the Precursors, I understand their tongue.
